stories.why: Consumer spending trends reflect household purchasing power and inflation dynamics in Africa's most industrialized economy.

stories.headline: Blue Star Posts 21% Revenue Growth as Margins Face Pressure
stories.summary: Blue Star reported a 21% surge in second-quarter revenue, though operating margins remained constrained by ongoing cost pressures.
stories.why: Blue Star is India's leading commercial air conditioning and refrigeration system producer.

impacts.name: Blue Star
impacts.why: Strong top-line sales growth was tempered by margin compression from elevated input expenses.

stories.headline: Nigeria Pension Industry Assets Reach N31.8 Trillion by August 2026
stories.summary: Nigeria's pension industry managed assets reaching N31.8 trillion by August 2026. The sector added N3.8 trillion in the first eight months of the year.
stories.why: Pension funds are key institutional investors driving capital market liquidity and infrastructure financing in Nigeria.
